qa_pair.question: Open the drawing at evaluations/fixtures/floor_plan.dxf with the acadmcp server. How many entities does drawing_status report in total? Answer with the number only.
Open evaluations/fixtures/floor_plan.dxf. Of the layers that hold at least one entity, which layer holds the most? Answer with just the layer name.
Open evaluations/fixtures/floor_plan.dxf and inspect the layer that carries the windows. How many entities sit on it? Answer with the number only.
Open evaluations/fixtures/floor_plan.dxf. How many distinct layers contain at least one entity? (The document defines more layers than it uses.) Answer with the number only.
Open evaluations/fixtures/floor_plan.dxf, then call listing_entities with limit=200. Does the response's has_more flag come back true or false? Answer True or False.
Using the acadmcp element catalogue (check_library=False), how many element types are offered in the "structure" category? Answer with the number only.
Using the acadmcp element catalogue, what is the default variant of the light-gauge steel stud (the 钢立柱 element)? Quote the variant name exactly.

In the acadmcp element catalogue, the plan-view window element (窗) is sized by a dynamic block parameter whose name is misleading — it says "door" although it drives a window. What is that parameter's exact name?
In the acadmcp element catalogue, exactly one element type carries an empty tag prefix, so placing it consumes no tag number. What is that element's key?
According to the acadmcp element catalogue, the recessed fluorescent light element (荧光灯) is imported from a block in which library drawing file? Answer with the file name only, not the directory.
